question: In 2025, the Commission Representation in Italy launched call for proposals COMM/IT/GRANTS/2025 for communication and media actions on the role of the European Union in Italy. Subsequently, in a communication of 5 September 2025, it announced that it was pushing back the timetable and increasing the overall budget, due to the high number of proposals received.

Moreover, some participants reported problems when taking part in the procedure and when trying to locate comprehensive information on the results. In the light of the principles of transparency, proportionality and equal treatment enshrined in the Financial Regulation, could the Commission answer the following questions: 1.

Is it aware of the procedural difficulties reported in relation to call for proposals COMM/IT/GRANTS/2025? Does it intend to verify internally that the selection criteria were correctly applied and that any measures to remedy errors in the procedure were properly implemented?

In order to ensure that the decisions are completely transparent and can be verified, will it make available the full ranking with the scores awarded to all eligible proposals, the list of beneficiaries and their evaluation reports?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (3.3.2026) The Commission acknowledges that the period for informing all applicants of the outcome of the evaluation has been extended beyond six months from the final date for submission of complete proposals in accordance with Article 197 paragraph 2 of the Financial Regulation1.

This extension, announced on the website of the Commission Representation in Italy2, was necessary due to the very high number of applications received (more than 300). As confirmed in the Evaluation Report and the Award Decision, the selection criteria were applied correctly and consistently.

The Commission also carried out the ex-ante control required for grant procedures, which confirmed the correctness and consistency of the process. The Commission respects all publication obligations it has pursuant to Article 38 of the Financial Regulation and will make available the list of beneficiaries and the amount awarded on the website of the Commission Representation in Italy3.
1 Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2024/2509 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 September 2024 on

the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union (recast), available at http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2509/oj. 2 https://italy.representation.ec.europa.eu/notizie-ed-eventi/notizie/comunicazione-invito-presentare-propostecommitgrants2025-2025-09-05_it. 3 https://italy.representation.ec.europa.eu/index_it.
